title: Squared contraction parameter bound
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q\ge0$ satisfy $p>0$ and $q>0$, let $\rho<1$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Suppose the uniform $q$-norm of $x\mapsto a+\rho bX(x)$ is at most the uniform $p$-norm of $x\mapsto a+bX(x)$ for all real $a,b$, and suppose the uniform expectation of $X^2$ is positive. Then $(q-1)\rho^2\le p-1$.
hypotheses_covered: The defining hypercontractive inequality holds for all real $a,b$
The uniform expectation of $X^2$ is positive
